prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Carbon (탄소) itself — the sovereign of the Carbon Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: two faces of one element: black soot and clear diamond; hexagonal lattices (graphite, graphene) as patterns, pencil-graphite grey, carbon-fibre weave; it bonds with everything and is the frame of all life. Palette: charcoal black, graphite grey, diamond white, a single living green.

World (fixed): year 2200, a city of graphene towers: hexagonal lattice facades, carbon-fibre weave surfaces, diamond-glass bridges. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) heavy assault bulk — big, thick shoulder and leg armor, a broad upper silhouette and large thrusters on the back and legs, while the torso stays fitted and the waist narrow; 2) several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them; 3) light body armor with several small shield and drone units floating symmetrically around her; 4) a symmetrical pair of mechanical sub-arms reaching out from her back, ending in shields or tools — her own two human arms stay as they are; 5) a large equipment unit worn on the back (tanks, a cannon barrel or antennae) rising above her head as the main shape, with medium body armor; 6) separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit showing between them; 7) complete full-body armor with plates joined seamlessly from neck to feet — bare skin only on the face and where EXPOSURE allows, dense visible seams and joints; 8) sparse outer plates over an exposed mechanical skeleton of metal struts, pistons and cables — light and precise; 9) a slender torso with oversized mechanical forearms and lower legs — huge gauntlets and boots — the contrast is the main shape; 10) mecha armor shaped like a medieval knight's plate — big rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, layered plates below the waist, a head ornament instead of a helmet so her face shows. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): charcoal black, graphite grey, diamond white, a single living green.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): soot-black hair with a graphite sheen. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (C) and atomic number (6) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

FINAL ORIGINAL DESIGN FOR THIS IMAGE: Choose silhouette 1, heavy assault bulk with massive thick shoulder and leg armor, a broad upper silhouette and large thrusters on back and legs, a fitted torso and narrow waist. Adult woman with a compact soft diamond-shaped face, warm beige skin, clear amber-brown eyes, straight defined brows, subtle smoky charcoal eyeliner, restrained red lips and a steady resolute expression. Soot-black hair with graphite sheen, a sharply layered short pixie cut and long diagonal bangs. Signature carbon construction: her massive rounded pauldrons and shin shields consist of many thick offset graphite lamellae like stacked graphene sheets; transparent diamond wedges lock the layers together, showing visible bolts and articulated joints; a thin living-green thermal channel runs through each stack. Opaque charcoal chest armor with a deep symmetrical chest window, bare shoulders and upper arms only between armor sections; every other part of torso, hips, thighs, knees and lower legs is plated in hard carbon-fibre armor. A compact paired thruster backpack rises behind the shoulders. Both empty natural human hands extend visibly from symmetrical large armored wrist cuffs, palms inward and fingers relaxed; no weapon. She stands in a strong balanced front-facing stance on a broad maintenance platform among year-2200 graphene towers and diamond-glass transit bridges in clear afternoon light. All fixed painterly anime style, palette and eye-level full-body framing above; no cloth or fabric skirt.

generation.note: 원본 PNG는 저장소에 올리지 않음. 생성 후 재생성하지 않음.

observations: 성인 여성 한 명이 주인공이며 일본 유화 애니 계열의 채색과 선을 유지
팔과 손이 신체에서 자연스럽게 이어짐; 보이는 손가락과 가려진 부분을 구분해 검수
선택 시트의 원본을 그대로 WebP로 변환
탄소의 흑연·다이아몬드 모티브, 해당 세계 의상과 배경 확인
C·6은 장면 속 의상이나 깃발에 표현됨

acceptance: 사용자 선택 3,3,4 및 완료 후 커밋·main 일반 반영 승인. 생성 후 노출 사유 재생성 금지.
